title: Personalized Nana Sweatshirt with Grandkids Names, Custom Grandma Sweatshirt, Crewneck
description:
A personalized Nana sweatshirt with the year she became Nana and every grandkid's name underneath. Made for the woman who keeps the whole family together.

💕 How to order
1. Type the year she became Nana.
2. Add one grandkid's name per box.
3. Double-check spelling. We print exactly what you type.

🧶 The sweatshirt
• Gildan 18000 unisex crewneck sweatshirt, cotton-poly blend
• Unisex sizes S to 3XL; see the size chart in the photos
• Wash inside out in cold water, tumble dry low

🎄 Christmas timing
Made in 3–6 business days, then 2–5 days shipping (US). Order by Tuesday, December 8 for Christmas.

💛 Our promise
Because each sweatshirt is made just for you, we can't take returns or exchanges. If it arrives damaged, misprinted, or different from what you typed, message us within 14 days with a photo and we'll replace it free.

Designed by Dinner Bell Co with the help of digital and AI tools. Names are set as real text. Printed and shipped by our production partner, Printify, from a US print shop.
